gloss: first dream of the new year

definitions.gloss: first dream of the new year
definitions.explanation: The first dream one has in the new year, traditionally on the night of January 1st or 2nd. In Japanese culture, certain dreams are considered auspicious.

examples.japanese: {初夢|はつゆめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I had my first dream of the year.

examples.japanese: {初夢|はつゆめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: Mt. Fuji appeared in my first dream of the year.
It is said that the most auspicious first dreams are 'first, Mt. Fuji; second, a hawk; third, an eggplant.'

notes:
{初夢|はつゆめ} is the first dream of the new year, traditionally the dream seen on the night of January 1st or 2nd.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The saying {一|いち}{富士|ふじ}⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦{鷹|たか}→鷹：02218_taka⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧なすび lists the three most auspicious things to dream of: Mt. Fuji, a hawk, and an eggplant. This saying dates back to the Edo period, and its origin is debated.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {初夢|はつゆめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to have one's first dream of the year
- {初夢|はつゆめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧: to appear in one's first dream

USAGE:
{初夢|はつゆめ} is a seasonal topic in Japanese conversation. People often share what they dreamed about as a lighthearted New Year's tradition. The content of the dream is sometimes taken as an omen for the year ahead.
